audience.text: Developers building .NET applications that require PDF processing capabilities, including document generation, form handling, security, and conversion to/from common formats.

capabilities.text: Create new PDFs or open existing ones, manipulate pages (add, delete, reorder, rotate, resize), and preserve bookmarks, outlines, and metadata on save.
capabilities.title: Document creation and editing

capabilities.text: Read, fill, and build AcroForm fields including text, checkbox, radio, choice, signature, and specialized fields like file-select and barcode.
capabilities.title: Form handling

capabilities.text: Extract text with absorbers, find and replace content including ligature-aware spans, and build formatted text with Bidi and Unicode mapping support.
capabilities.title: Text processing

capabilities.text: Render pages to PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, or SVG using pluggable renderers, and export to Markdown, PDF/A, and PDF/UA-1.
capabilities.title: Rendering and export

capabilities.text: Encrypt with RC4-40/128 and AES-128/256, sign with PKCS#1 and PKCS#7/CMS, support DocMDP, timestamps, and external signatures.
capabilities.title: Security and signing

capabilities.text: Read and build tagged content with logical structure, support PDF/UA auto-tagging, and set language, title, and alternate text.
capabilities.title: Accessibility and structure

capabilities.text: Add and edit link, text, free-text, highlight, ink, stamp, redaction, watermark, and pre-press annotations with appearance generation.
capabilities.title: Annotations and stamps

capabilities.text: Convert PDF to/from HTML, SVG, Markdown, plain text, XML, and PostScript using dedicated load and save options.
capabilities.title: Conversion and integration

limitations.text: Members that take or return System.Drawing images are Windows-only and throw PlatformNotSupportedException on Linux/macOS.
DocumentCollection.GetEnumerator() is not implemented and throws NotImplementedException.
OCSP and CRL revocation checks are not implemented; validation reports undefined result when requested.
Rendering is not pixel-identical across platforms due to differences in GDI+ and managed renderer implementations.
Dynamic XFA forms are read and flattened but fine-grained authoring of individual XFA dataset fields remains limited.
PDF/A conversion reports unrepairable content in the conversion log rather than fixing it.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF creation, editing, and conversion without requiring Adobe Acrobat or other proprietary tools.
Supports PDF/A and PDF/UA-1 compliance through conversion options and auto-tagging settings.
Provides tools for form filling, annotation management, digital signing, and document redaction.
Offers text extraction, comparison, and accessibility features including logical structure and tagged content support.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET library for reading, creating, modifying, and converting PDF documents, supporting .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Standard 2.0, and .NET 8+.

workflows.name: Create and save PDF
workflows.text: Create a new PDF document using the Document class, add pages, content, and save to file or stream.

workflows.name: Extract text and data
workflows.text: Use TextAbsorber, TableAbsorber, and related classes to extract text, tables, and structured content from PDFs.

workflows.name: Convert between formats
workflows.text: Convert PDF to HTML, SVG, Markdown, or plain text using dedicated load and save options.

workflows.name: Sign and secure documents
workflows.text: Apply digital signatures using PKCS#1 or PKCS#7, encrypt with RC4 or AES, and set document permissions.

workflows.name: Stamp and annotate
workflows.text: Add text, image, or Bates number stamps, and insert annotations like links, highlights, and free text.

workflows.name: Compare documents
workflows.text: Perform side-by-side, text-based, or graphical comparison of PDF documents using dedicated comparer classes.
